summary_en: Keywest Network acquired 43,265,702 Future Corporation shares through a tender offer that closed on September 10, 2026, bringing its ownership to over 50% and establishing it as a new parent company. The acquisition also resulted in major shareholder Yasufumi Kanemaru's stake falling below the threshold for classification as a principal shareholder, as Keywest acquired 5,558,700 of his 11,117,400 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Future Corporation Shares by Keywest Network Corporation and Changes in Parent Company and Principal Shareholders
translation_en_brief:
Keywest Network Corporation completed a tender offer for Future Corporation on September 10, 2026, successfully acquiring 43,265,702 shares. Settlement is scheduled to begin on September 17, 2026. Based on the outstanding share count as of June 30, 2026 (95,328,000 total issued shares, 6,593,434 held as treasury stock), the acquired shares represent approximately 48.7% of the shares eligible for voting purposes (calculated from the 88,734,566 share base excluding treasury stock).

Following settlement, Keywest Network's voting rights will exceed 50% of Future Corporation's total shareholder voting power, establishing it as a new parent company. DANA POINT Corporation PTE. LTD., which is Keywest Network's sole shareholder, will also become a parent company through indirect ownership. Additionally, Yasufumi Kanemaru, who was a principal shareholder of Future Corporation, had 5,558,700 of his 11,117,400 shares acquired through the tender offer, reducing his remaining stake to below the threshold for classification as a principal shareholder. Kanemaru serves as both a director and chairman of Future Corporation and as representative director of Keywest Network.
